notes_for_editor: NRHP 88001837 nomination is not digitised, so there is no nomination. No newspaper account found on Chronicling America (one search). Prior's log is read through Terry Pepper's transcription, not the logbook; the transcription has internal oddities (typo dates 'May 11, 1889', 'July 11, 18990', Heater's transfer letter given twice, 'Harry W.' vs 'William H.' Prior). Pepper calls the added assistant 'third'; Lighthouse Friends and the roster show a second assistant from 1903. Light height conflicts: LF 89 ft focal plane / 64 ft tower, Pepper 105 ft, USLHS 108 ft; record has 20 m. Brief says range 60 nm; operator says 20 nm; brief's 'Fl W 5s' not checked. Whether still lit: operator says active aid. LHB 1897 table says 22 Oct 1896, text says 20 Oct. LHB 1899 coal figure OCR'd as '0 tons'; not used. Bulletin 1913 storm paragraph: the stations' paragraph follows the 8-10 Nov storm text, matched by position. Pepper says Prior died on 27 June; the log and others say disappeared 28 June. Remains found 14 Nov 1902 per log; cause of death not stated by any source and the story does not state one. Scan pages (not printed pages) are cited for the LHB volumes except 1895 (printed p. 157 from the OCR head). 1961 buyer: 'Jon' (LF) vs 'John' (Pepper) Pick; story says Dr. Pick.
